about.title: Building the ERP Africa deserves
about.subtitle: Orbis ERP was born in 2022 in Conakry, with a simple belief: African businesses deserve management tools designed for their realities, not retrofitted from abroad.
about.missionBody: Empower every African business leader to make informed decisions through a unified view of their company. Democratize world-class ERP at a fair price.
about.visionBody: Become the reference ERP in West Africa, backed by a local team, certified integrator partners and an ecosystem of open modules.

values.title: Local excellence

values.title: Radical transparency

values.title: Digital sovereignty

values.title: Continuous innovation
